title: MusicDrop v1.5.9 Available
changelog:
• Fixed Song Selection in Device & Download Tabs: Clicking a song in the Device or Download tab now reliably plays the exact clicked track rather than defaulting to track index 0 or another song
• Robust Track Indexing & Fallback: Playback connection now cross-references track ID, file path, and URI, guaranteeing the selected track is played immediately
• Fixed Double Audio / Simultaneous Video Autoplay: Playing an audio track strictly resets player view to Audio mode and prevents background YouTube video resolution from playing audio concurrently
• Queue & Autoplay Isolation: Local track playback now clears stale online queue items and prevents online recommendation streams from unexpectedly hijacking offline listening sessions
